note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each of the five wards of Londonderry Corporation; nominations Thursday 5 January 1933, poll in January (the count was on 17 January). Only the South Ward was contested (Derry Journal, 6, 9 and 18 January 1933). M'Gahey, a retiring member, was described at nomination as an Independent Unionist; the other retiring member, J. F. Rooney, did not stand. Callaghan, a former member, had represented the ward until 1931; Doherty had represented the West Ward. The Journal's analysis of plumpers and cross-votes (Callaghan 399 plumpers; Callaghan and Doherty 718, Callaghan and M'Gahey 248) adds to 1,365 for Callaghan, not the printed 1,344; the printed figure is kept.
